label: Manifesto de Marca (60s) · O Design Invisível (Minimalismo & Dieter Rams)
description: Manifesto conceitual de design industrial em 16:9: superfícies de alumínio anodizado fosco, linhas de corte milimétricas, eliminação de todo elemento supérfluo e harmonia ergonômica absoluta.
resources: sound design tátil sutil de mecanismos puros

scenes.prompt: Pure minimalist industrial design manifesto cinematography in 16:9. A seamless, pristine matte white studio space. A single solid monolithic block of bead-blasted natural aluminum sits bathed in soft, diffused Nordic morning light. 85mm prime lens. Non-verbal sound design: profound peaceful room tone, subtle airy breath. No speech or dialogue. On-screen text: O SILÊNCIO DA FORMA.

Pure minimalist industrial design manifesto cinematography in 16:9. Extreme macro tracking shot across an unbroken chamfered edge. A human finger glides slowly across the cool, satin metal surface with effortless tactile smoothness. Non-verbal sound design: soft whisper of skin gliding over satin bead-blasted aluminum. No speech or dialogue. On-screen text: MENOS, MAS MELHOR.

Pure minimalist industrial design manifesto cinematography in 16:9. A single tactile dial rotates with ultra-smooth damped rotational resistance. Microscopic index markings align with zero backlash under a crisp razor-thin slit of white light. Non-verbal sound design: damped, satisfying, buttery mechanical rotary detent clicks. No speech or dialogue. On-screen text: FUNÇÃO PURA.

Pure minimalist industrial design manifesto cinematography in 16:9. Exploded isometric view in ultra slow motion: complex interior components seamlessly collapse into a unified, ultra-thin monolithic unibody enclosure with zero visible screws or gaps. Non-verbal sound design: soft magnetic snap and low harmonic sine wave chord. No speech or dialogue. On-screen text: A COMPLEXIDADE INVISÍVEL.

Pure minimalist industrial design manifesto cinematography in 16:9. An architect sits in a sun-drenched minimalist concrete living room, interacting with the device effortlessly without looking down, completely immersed in music and thought. Non-verbal sound design: warm ambient cello tones and gentle piano chords. No speech or dialogue. On-screen text: A SERVIÇO DA VIDA.

Pure minimalist industrial design manifesto cinematography in 16:9. Hero brand lockup: the finished iconic object sits in perfect geometric harmony on a raw oak plinth. Pure, timeless, uncluttered typography appears center frame. Non-verbal sound design: pure acoustic chime decaying into complete silence. No speech or dialogue. On-screen text: O DESIGN INVISÍVEL.

narration.text: O bom design não grita por atenção. Ele resolve, simplifica e sai do caminho. Quando um objeto atinge a sua forma perfeita, você deixa de ver a ferramenta e passa a viver apenas a experiência.
narration.voice: voz masculina brasileira madura, aveludada, culta, calma, elegante e pausada, estilo manifesto de design escandinavo / Dieter Rams

blocks.text: O bom design não grita por atenção.
Ele elimina o excesso para revelar a essência.
Cada detalhe existe para servir a uma função clara.
A verdadeira sofisticação é tornar a complexidade invisível.
Objetos que respeitam o seu tempo e o seu espaço.
O design invisível. Criado para permanecer.

audio.musicIntent: Refined neoclassical minimalist score with felt piano, subtle violin textures, warm ambient synthesizers and pristine spatial production.
